content: The ACC 2009 schedule outlines the coordination of interviews and presentations during the conference, which will take place at the Rosen Plaza Hotel, located at 9700 International Drive. The filming will occur from Saturday, March 28, to Tuesday, March 31, 2009. Dr. Gibson is available for interviews during the times listed in black, while the times listed in green indicate his unavailability. Presenters are encouraged to proceed with their presentations and slide discussions during the designated times. Saturday, March 28, 2009 Presentations will occur throughout the day. Dr. Gibson will not be available for interviews between 2:00 PM and 5:00 PM. Presenters should proceed with their topics and slides during these times. 2:00 PM: Interviewee: Gilles Montalescot Topic: Immediate vs. Next-Day Catheterization in Non-ST Elevation Acute Coronary Syndrome (Results of the Multicenter Randomized ABOARD Study) Confirmation: Yes Phone: +33 6 1259 2326 Sunday, March 29, 2009 Presentations will occur throughout the day. Dr. Gibson will not be available for interviews between 7:00 AM and 11:00 AM, 1:30 PM to 4:00 PM, and 6:00 PM to 9:30 PM.
